vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm and A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut are comparing scars like trading cards.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
❓ James just told you something about the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — says they're not really from Kyoto, Japan. Worth remembering.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm).

👂 Overheard — James (to Ramandeep): "the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm?" James lowers their voice. "Between us — they're not from Denver. They're from Kyoto, Japan. Don't say who told you."
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Asher passes around a giant emergent tree dropping heavy cannonball pods the size of a head. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about Austin. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ramandeep telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Asher, Austin, Ramandeep, Ignacio and James met them at the door — 4 put down. Ignacio didn't come back. Asher, Austin, Ramandeep, James are hurt.
🛡️ Asher, Austin, Ramandeep and James met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Asher, Austin, Ramandeep, James are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Asher, Austin, Ramandeep and James met them at the door — 4 put down. Asher, Austin, Ramandeep, James are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ James, Sanne and Quinn met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. James, Sanne, Quinn are hurt.
🛡️ Sanne and Nino met them at the door — 2 put down. Sanne, Nino are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Loud Stare... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sanne, Nino, Diana, Tariq and Paramjit met them at the door — 5 put down. Sanne, Nino, Diana, Tariq, Paramjit are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Diana taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Paramjit showed Nino the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Diana is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Lindani met them at the door — 1 put down. Lindani is hurt.
🛡️ Zhasulan met them at the door — 1 put down. Zhasulan is hurt.
